#!/bin/sh
# Boot helpers. Never change the USB gadget. Never insmod rockit.
# Wi-Fi always joins /userdata/wpa_camevision.conf (Camemake R&D center).
chmod 755 /userdata/camevision-wifi.sh /userdata/camevision-imu.sh /userdata/camevision-stream.sh /userdata/camevision-led.sh 2>/dev/null
# RGB D1: green=OK, red/blue off. DT leaves red on panic trigger (looks like a fault LED).
if [ -x /userdata/camevision-led.sh ]; then
  /userdata/camevision-led.sh
else
  echo none > /sys/class/leds/status:red/trigger 2>/dev/null
  echo 0 > /sys/class/leds/status:red/brightness 2>/dev/null
  echo none > /sys/class/leds/status:green/trigger 2>/dev/null
  echo 1 > /sys/class/leds/status:green/brightness 2>/dev/null
  echo none > /sys/class/leds/status:blue/trigger 2>/dev/null
  echo 0 > /sys/class/leds/status:blue/brightness 2>/dev/null
fi
( sleep 8
  if [ -x /userdata/camevision-imu.sh ]; then
    /userdata/camevision-imu.sh >/userdata/imu-boot.log 2>&1
  fi
) &
